name: Scope authority-refresh loading to profiles that can confer proxy capability
description: Including every isProfilesFetching state in ProfileProvider isLoading combines with staleTime zero and refetchOnMount always to replace the whole app with a loading screen on mount and every active-state resume, even for learner-only profiles that cannot confer proxy authority.
acceptanceCriteria: Root cause: WI-2128 added every isProfilesFetching state to ProfileProvider isLoading while useProfiles has staleTime zero and refetchOnMount always, so mount and AppState-active background refreshes replace the whole app with loading UI even for learner-only profiles. 1. Keep the full authority-refresh loading barrier only when the cached profile set can confer owner/guardian/proxy capability or when no validated profile state exists; learner-only self sessions retain usable content during a background refetch. 2. Do not expose stale owner/proxy authority while refresh is pending, failed, or returns a changed organization/person binding. 3. Mandatory regression tests must fail on the current global-loading implementation and pass with the fix for cold start, learner-only mount, owner-with-charge mount, joined learner, AppState-active resume, repeated focus/refetch, refresh success/failure, and role/capability transition. 4. Demonstrate refetch cadence remains intentional and no redirect, shell, or consent gate flashes during the scoped refresh. 5. Run mobile typecheck, focused/full mobile tests, and applicable change-class gates.
